points.description: First valid advantage of Industry 4.0 stated, e.g. higher quality products made with minimal human intervention / in less time using smart machines and advanced technologies, or efficient processes (saving time, lower cost per piece, less wasted raw material).
points.partial_credit: Half mark if the advantage is vague or only loosely linked to Industry 4.0 (e.g. just 'better' or 'faster' with no detail).

points.description: Second, distinct valid advantage of Industry 4.0 (from the model answer's ideas: superior quality/less human intervention/less time, or efficient time and cost/less material waste). It must differ from the first advantage.
points.partial_credit: Half mark if the advantage is vague or only loosely linked to Industry 4.0.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for two distinct, correct advantages such as better quality with less human intervention, or greater efficiency (less time, lower cost, less waste); clear synonyms are fine. Give 1 mark if only one valid advantage is given, or if both are vague. Give 0 for wrong or unrelated answers; a restatement of the same advantage counts once only.
